GetUniqueNcidForRepresentations
Method.Implementation:
#dim reqObj As IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Interface.Object
$$$TRACE("GetUniqueNcidForRepresentations ")
set listInd = pRequest.listOfHddNcidObj.Next("") set list = ##class(%ListOfObjects).%New() while ( listInd '= "") { set ncid = "" set reqObj = pRequest.listOfHddNcidObj.GetAt(listInd) Do ..GetUniqueNcidByRep(reqObj.Rep, reqObj.Domain, reqObj.Context, .ncid)
set hddObj = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Interface.Object).%New() set hddObj.Comment = "Gets Unique Ncid for Representation" set hddObj.NCID = ncid set hddObj.Context = reqObj.Context set hddObj.Domain = reqObj.Domain set hddObj.Rep = reqObj.Rep set hddObj.Index = reqObj.Index Do list.Insert(hddObj) set listInd = pRequest.listOfHddNcidObj.Next(listInd) } set pResponse = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Interface.LookupResponse).%New() set pResponse.listOfHDDobj = list
Quit $$$OK

GetHelp1BillingTypeFromHddBillingTypeCache
Method.Implementation: set billingTypeStr = "" Do ..ClearHddTables() &sql(select BillingTypeRep into :billingTypeStr from IHC_ITF_ITFCOMMON_DataStructure.BillingTypeCache where BillingTypeNcid = :billingTypeNcid) return billingTypeStr

Method.name: GetHddRepForNcidFromHddRepCache
Method.Implementation: set repStr = "" Do ..ClearHddTables() &sql(select Representation into :repStr from IHC_ITF_ITFCOMMON_DataStructure.HddRepCache where Ncid = :ncid and HddContext = :cnxt) return repStr

Method.name: GetHddNcidForRepFromHddNcidCache
Method.Implementation: set ncidStr = "" Do ..ClearHddTables() &sql(select Ncid into :ncidStr from IHC_ITF_ITFCOMMON_DataStructure.HddNcidCache where Representation = :rep and HddDomain = :dom and HddContext = :cnxt) return ncidStr
